title: Emit deploy-annotation events for runtime_version + git_sha (perf canary correlation)
author: Connor O'Brien
body:
Problem: perf-canary dashboards are currently hard to correlate with runtime deploys. We have request-scoped tags (source=perf-canary) and runtime_build labels on request metrics, but the Grafana view still requires manual cross-referencing to figure out when a runtime version actually rolled in a region and what git SHA it corresponds to.

This PR adds a small, explicit deploy annotation event emitted from the runtime deployment pipeline into our metrics/annotation stream so Grafana can render vertical deploy lines and show (runtime_version, git_sha) in hover tooltips. This is intentionally low-cardinality and decoupled from request metrics.

What changed: add a new "deploy annotation" emission path for serving-runtime deploys. The event includes service=serving-runtime, runtime_version (human version / build tag), git_sha (full 40-char), environment (prod/staging), region, and a release_train identifier. Telemetry pipeline writes these events into the existing annotations bucket used by Grafana. Dashboards can filter by region and service and show the most recent deploy annotation on the panel.

Design notes: these are events, not timeseries; they should not contribute to metric cardinality or query amplification. Payload schema is intentionally fixed, with explicit allowlist of keys. git_sha is included as a string field in the annotation payload, not a label. runtime_version remains as a string field as well.

Operational: emission is triggered by the deploy controller on successful rollout completion (not at start) to avoid spurious annotations during aborted rollouts. We also emit a "rollback" annotation with the same schema when a runtime_version moves backwards.

Testing: unit tests cover schema validation + allowlist enforcement. E2E test in staging validates that the annotation shows up in Grafana within the expected ingestion delay.

Rollout: gated to serving-runtime only; no changes for other services. Can be expanded later if useful.

Screenshots/links: staging Grafana panel shows deploy lines for us-east; hover tooltip includes runtime_version + git_sha.

Related: ENG-2847 (dashboards), ENG-2846 (regression detector wants automatic links to recent deploys).
commits: 1) telemetry/annotations: add DeployAnnotation schema + validation allowlist 2) release/deployer: emit runtime deploy-complete annotation event (region/env/runtime_version/git_sha) 3) grafana: add annotation datasource query helper + docs 4) tests: staging e2e asserting deploy annotation ingestion

review_conversation:
Logan Wright: Can we confirm none of these fields become labels? We cannot afford git_sha label cardinality in the metrics backend. Connor O'Brien (author): Yes—this is an annotation event payload. Schema validator rejects unknown keys and we explicitly do not map payload keys into labels. git_sha/runtime_version are stored as event fields only.

Allison Grant: Please align naming with observability standards; use "git_sha" not "sha", and "runtime_version" not "build". Also confirm region naming uses our canonical region IDs. Connor O'Brien: Updated schema keys to git_sha/runtime_version; region uses deployment region slug (us-east/eu-west) and is validated.

Felix Schneider: For dashboards, can we filter by service + region only? Also, is there a "rollback" marker? Connor O'Brien: Yes—dashboards can query annotations by service + region. Added rollback annotation type with same schema; Grafana uses color to differentiate.

Rafael Mendes: Please ensure we emit on deploy completion only; we had false positives from started-but-aborted deploy annotations in the past. Connor O'Brien: Emission moved to post-rollout completion hook; added test that aborted deploy does not emit.

Felix Schneider (approval): Looks good. This unblocks deploy correlation in perf-canary.

Logan Wright (approval): Approved with the payload-vs-label clarification + schema tests.

Allison Grant (approval): Approved after naming fixes + docs link.
release_notes: Internal: Serving-runtime deploys now emit Grafana deploy annotations including runtime_version + git_sha for easier perf-canary correlation.
